limitations: No build, test, JVM or GPU run: every verdict is a Git-object/patch comparison, not an executed test result.
`refs/t3/orchestration-v2/*` (183 refs) are T3 checkpoint refs, not branches; they are out of scope and untouched.
PR reads are live GitHub reads at the stamp in snapshot.pr_read_utc; all 7 open PR heads match the local remote-tracking objects.
Remote-tracking refs match the live remote for all 9 heads at snapshot time; no fetch or prune was run.
Dirty worktree contents were read (status/diffstat), never staged, stashed or modified.
Porcelain status can be momentarily inconsistent while an owning task writes; ACTIVE rows are observations, not pins.
Equivalence for the six same-subject/patch-id-different branches is a bounded diff-of-diffs judgement; the drift lines are listed in each row.
